en.headline: Communications Authority approves HKT's plan to end 3G services on 25 February 2027
en.dek: The regulator cited the low number of affected users and HKT's support measures, including device-replacement offers, while requiring satisfactory service until the termination date.
body: The Communications Authority has given prior consent for Hong Kong Telecommunications Limited (HKT) to terminate its third-generation (3G) mobile services on 25 February 2027.

The approval, under special condition 10.4 of HKT's unified carrier licence, took into account the low proportion of customers who would be affected, including users of 3G devices and older 4G phones that support only an earlier version of VoLTE technology.

HKT has prepared support measures such as device-replacement offers. For customers who choose not to replace devices and discontinue service, the company will make reasonable termination arrangements, give ample advance notice and provide customer-service support. The authority has required HKT to maintain satisfactory 3G service until the scheduled date.

The Office of the Communications Authority reminded users of 3G services and older devices to upgrade plans and handsets, and encouraged people to help family members, especially elderly users, make the switch. More than 99 per cent of mobile users in Hong Kong already use 4G or 5G services.

zh.headline: 通訊局批准HKT於2027年2月25日終止3G服務
zh.dek: 通訊局考慮受影響客戶比例低及HKT的支援措施包括換機優惠，並要求在終止日前維持令人滿意的服務。
body: 通訊事務管理局已事先同意香港電訊有限公司（HKT）於2027年2月25日終止提供第三代流動（3G）服務。
批准根據HKT綜合傳送者牌照特別條件第10.4條作出，考慮到受影響客戶比例低，包括仍使用3G裝置以及只支援舊版本VoLTE技術的較舊型號4G手機用戶。
HKT已準備支援措施，例如更換裝置優惠方案。對於選擇不更換裝置而終止服務的客戶，公司會作出合理終止安排、充分提前通知並提供客戶服務支援。通訊局要求HKT在預定終止日前繼續維持令人滿意的3G服務。
通訊辦提醒3G服務用戶及使用舊裝置的市民儘快升級服務計劃及手機，並鼓勵市民協助家人尤其是長者升級。本港現時超過九成九的流動用戶已使用4G或5G服務。
